Why do fishing cats purr but leopards roar? Researchers hypothesize that this difference between the two feline species may be partly due to a U-shaped bone in their throats called the hyoid. These traits allow leopards and most other species of big cats to produce powerful roars. The same traits may also prevent most big cats from purring.
